audit.whatIsWrong: The lane read leaned on an Aatrox mechanic that no longer exists.
audit.why: Three places said World Ender gives a "revive". Riot's current text for World Ender is fear on nearby minions plus AD, increased healing and Move Speed, extended on a takedown — there is no revive. Advice built on surviving a lethal hit is advice a player will trust and die to.
audit.corrected: Revive wording removed from spikes[1], whys[4], mid and late; the real heal amp / combat stats are stated instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described his ult window without a cooldown.
audit.why: Purgatory is 120/100/80s, so the safe window after he spends it is nearly two minutes early on — that is the whole plan for his first-item spike.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now give the 120s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive kit facts were absent: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s, and Soul Ignition is self-damage first, heal later.
audit.why: Riot's text: Soul Ignition "deals damage to himself... At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes". Killing or disengaging him before that end-of-duration payout is the concrete punish, and his gap-closer being a flat 10s tells you exactly how long you are safe.
audit.corrected: early now gives the Ashen Pursuit 10s window; late states the Soul Ignition health cost.

edits.before: World Ender's revive normally wins all-ins, but his Purgatory totem can execute straight through it. Track his R before every commit.
edits.after: An all-in normally goes your way at 6, but Purgatory executes you outright — and it is 120s at rank 1. Track his R before every commit.

edits.before: At 6 it's even — World Ender's revive normally wins you the all-in, but his Purgatory totem can execute right through it, so it comes down to R timing on both sides.
edits.after: At 6 it's even — World Ender's heal amp and combat stats normally win you the all-in, but Purgatory can execute you outright, so it comes down to R timing on both sides.

edits.before: At 6 the all-in looks yours on paper, but his Purgatory totem can execute through World Ender's revive — check his R before every commit. His first-item spike is the most dangerous stage of the lane: keep your HP topped, shove and reset rather than brawling at half health, and take fights in the windows right after his ult is spent.
edits.after: At 6 the all-in looks yours on paper, but Purgatory executes low targets outright — check his R before every commit. His first-item spike is the most dangerous stage of the lane: keep your HP topped, shove and reset rather than brawling at half health, and fight in the 120s window right after his ult is spent.

edits.before: Two items on, your sustain catches back up to his burst and the matchup evens. Drag every fight long — the more autos and Q rotations you land, the more you out-heal his damage. In teamfights, save the revive for his execute attempt and knock him up mid-combo to buy your carries time.
edits.after: Two items on, your sustain catches back up to his burst and the matchup evens. Drag every fight long — the more autos and Q rotations you land, the more you out-heal his damage, and Soul Ignition costs him health up front before it pays back. In fights, knock him up mid-combo to buy your carries time.

edits.before: Hold R for your revive window
edits.after: Hold Purgatory for your low HP

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are a pure skill lane. Your Q outranges his walk-up poke but the cooldown is long, so never whiff into the wave — Q the spots he has to stand on to CS, and answer his on-hit trades with a sweet-spot Q1 into W. Neither side has a hard commit tool yet, so win it on spacing.
edits.after: Levels 1-5 are a pure skill lane. Your Q outranges his walk-up poke but the cooldown is long, so never whiff into the wave — Q the spots he must stand on to CS, and answer his Silver Stake on-hit trades with a sweet-spot Q1 into W. Ashen Pursuit (E) is a flat 10s: punish the window after he spends it.

notes: World Ender (R) has no revive in Riot's current text — it fears nearby minions and grants AD, increased healing and Move Speed, extended on a takedown. Any "revive" wording is stale and was corrected here; other champions' pages may still carry it. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only), so no grounding claim was made in this slice.
